thread:
Marta (Runtime): Follow-up from today's all-hands: folks asked about the adaptive batching + kernel rollout sequencing. Short thread to align.
Sam (CTO): High level: ship fixed-window improvements next week, start adaptive batching alpha in 3 weeks, kernel mem-tiling canary in ~6 weeks.
Diego (ML): Adaptive needs a cheap token-estimator. Proposal: gateway runs a 1-layer estimator on first 8 tokens if client hint missing. Accuracy ~85%.
Priya (Product): Can we default adaptive off for Dedicated until we've validated to avoid tenant surprise?
Marta (Runtime): Yes, Hosted default on, Dedicated opt-in. We'll expose tenant flag and SDK opt-out.
Liam (SRE): Ops note: adaptive increases burstiness. We'll update autoscale policy to use 95th+ window and add a p99 alert if CPU/GPU queueing exceeds 250ms.
perf-bot: Lab numbers: mixed-chat workload p99 fixed=410ms, adaptive=260ms; seq1024 kernel microbench p99 improved 140ms->90ms. Artifacts: artifact://perf/1882000123/v1.tar.gz
Sam (CTO): Action items: Marta write rollout RFC, Diego add estimator testcases, Priya draft customer note, Liam add SLO change. Post PRs here once ready.
Marta (Runtime): Will do 44d dropping RFC link in 48h. Keep updates brief here.
